20.evidenceText: SCHWALBE Clik Valve Conversion Set 3540 Sclaverand-Ventil Umrüstset. SCHWALBE Clik Valve Conversion Kit 3543 Dunlop-Ventil Umrüstset Ventileinsätze.
20.extractionRationale: Only Source 1 (Wetterladen eBay shop) contains listings for actual CLIK valve products (Conversion Sets/Kits). Sources 2 and 3 mention "Clik 25" but refer to RC airplane models, not valve products. Therefore, 1 distinct URL listing the target valve product.

36.evidenceText: The provided source content describes pump head adapters and compatibility but does not explicitly show a 'frequently bought together' or 'related products' section with accessory listings.
36.extractionRationale: The evidence provides product description mentioning accessories (pump heads, adapters) but does not contain quantitative data about the fraction of product pages displaying related accessories in dedicated merchandising sections. A single product page example is insufficient to calculate an attach rate across all Clik valve listings globally.

37.evidenceText: The source page describes CoreCap Valve Cap Set but does not provide a list or count of replacement/spare part SKUs for valve cores, seals, o-rings, or replacement kits.
37.extractionRationale: The provided evidence does not contain specific information about the number of distinct replacement/spare part SKUs available. While SKU fields are referenced in the interface, no actual SKU count or list of spare parts is provided in the source content.

45.evidenceText: The DT Swiss tubeless valve perfectly matches DT Swiss rims, to ensure a perfect seal for long, hassle-free rides. DT Swiss uses their own proprietary tubeless valve system.
45.extractionRationale: The evidence shows DT Swiss uses their own proprietary tubeless valve system, not Clik. No evidence in any of the 4 sources indicates adoption of Clik valve by any of the 6 major brands (DT Swiss, Mavic, Hunt, Zipp, ENVE, Roval) in 2026 or 2027 product lines. Therefore, 0% of major brands have converted.
